title: Fish Oil and Alpha Lipoic Acid in Treating Alzheimer's Disease

sections.abstract:
The purpose of this study is to determine the effect of fish oil and the antioxidant alpha lipoic acid on factors in the blood that are associated with the progression of Alzheimer's Disease (AD).

Posted outcomes: F2-isoprostane Level Urine F2-Isoprostanes. timeframe=baseline, 12 months. Placebo=0.40 (±1.10); Fish Oil=-2.02 (±3.30); Fish Oil Plus Lipoic Acid=0.45 (±0.53). p=0.83
